questions.question: In a MOS capacitor operating at high frequency, what physical mechanism explains why the capacitance remains at minimum for Vgb > Vth?

answers.a: Minority carriers cannot respond quickly enough to the AC signal
answers.d: The majority carriers are completely depleted

explanations.a: Correct! At high frequencies (>1kHz), minority carriers cannot be generated and recombined fast enough to respond to the AC signal, resulting in minimum capacitance.
explanations.b: Incorrect. While the depletion width does reach maximum, this alone doesn't explain the capacitance behavior.
explanations.c: Incorrect. The oxide thickness remains constant regardless of operating conditions.
explanations.d: Incorrect. Majority carriers are depleted but this isn't why capacitance remains minimum.

questions.question: How does the flat-band voltage (VFB) change if positive fixed oxide charges are introduced in the oxide layer?

explanations.a: Incorrect. Positive fixed charges in oxide shift VFB in the negative direction.
explanations.b: Correct! According to VFB = ΦMS - Qf/Cox, positive fixed charges (Qf) make VFB more negative.
explanations.c: Incorrect. Fixed charges directly affect VFB.
explanations.d: Incorrect. VFB depends on both work function difference and oxide charges.

questions.question: In a p-type MOS capacitor, what happens to the energy bands and carrier distribution when transitioning from depletion to weak inversion?

answers.b: Bands remain flat, no carrier change
answers.c: Bands bend downward, electron concentration at surface approaches hole concentration
answers.d: Bands bend randomly, carriers distribute uniformly

explanations.a: Incorrect. Upward band bending occurs in accumulation.
explanations.b: Incorrect. Bands do bend during this transition.
explanations.c: Correct! The bands bend downward more, and at weak inversion the electron (minority) concentration approaches the hole concentration at the surface.
explanations.d: Incorrect. Band bending is systematic, not random.

questions.question: Which of the following are true for depletion width after voltage increases beyond threshold voltage (in Low frequency response case)?

answers.a: Depletion width keeps on increasing with same proportion
answers.d: Depletion width more of less remain constant
